title: 街路自動販売機
description: 独立した商品棚と缶、透明窓、操作部、受取口を備えた汎用自動販売機。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 繰り返し部品は材質と構成単位ごとに統合済み。
descriptionEn: Generic stocked vending cabinet with transparent display, separate cans and shelves, keypad, payment hardware, delivery pocket and rear cooling louvers. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Repeated static details are grouped by material and assembly; the procedural source retains the editable construction.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.

provenance.tool: Blender 4.3.2; Meshcopia city generator 1.0; Meshcopia attribute-preserving static grouping 1.0
provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.

staticGrouping.positionOperation: translation baked to float32; validate roundoff bound
staticGrouping.normalUvMaterialOperation: source float values/material JSON preserved; no normal recomputation
